journeyLoot.goal: Every player level has meaningful gear progression without requiring a unique static item definition at every level.
journeyLoot.scaling: Generated loot is normalized to the requested player/content item level; affixes, power and armor scale from the nearest authored base item.
journeyLoot.world: World drops use the current progression band and build/class targeting.
journeyLoot.dungeons: Dungeon variants provide higher source quality and tier-appropriate item levels.
journeyLoot.chase: Legendary and set chase items remain build-defining rather than mandatory stat sticks.
